scope: Exploration-only diagnostic on author rod environment; this cannot reproduce downstream rod-balancing Table 1 because the released repository has no SysID/CEM evaluation pipeline or trained policies.
task: rod inertia exploration; 2D end-effector position deltas at 10 Hz; fixed 20-action episode
observations: authors' 18-dimensional flattened end-effector position, robot qpos/gripper and rod pose, with author observation noise; hidden inertia not provided to policy
metric: author ASID finite-difference Fisher information proxy accumulated across 20 steps and rod displacement; neither is downstream task success
pairing: same fixed inertia and same initial random seed/observation noise draws per pair, separate action-generator RNG; independently reset episodes
video_note: renderer shows blue visual marker attached to hidden mass, but policy receives no RGB images
compute_budget: 4 cases x 2 policies x 20 author env steps; CPU; no paid API; keep all failures
